hero.description: These buildings are all attached and constitute the main entrance and lecture halls of the Medical College of Wisconsin. The Health Research Center is the brick building in the center front and is the main entrance of the complex, the Medical Education Building is in the center back (partially obscured, concrete portion visible on the right), and Hub for Collaborative Medicine is on the left. There are additional research buildings in the complex which are not visible in this photograph.
